## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: Filing-index table
      Objective: Ingest the real quarterly and daily index files into one filing-index table.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: nothing (package scaffolds only)
      Produces: a filing-index table that names each filing's submission and form type; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: O1 — the table holds rows from every quarterly index file through the last closed quarter and every daily index file since, and can be queried by CIK, form type and filing date; the findings file records the real run's elapsed time, files and bytes downloaded, and row count.
      Leaves out: manifests and replay (Stage 4); correction tracking (Stage 5); validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Submission download
      Objective: Download the individual submissions that the filing-index rows name.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 1's filing-index table
      Produces: submissions on disk, addressable from their filing-index row, with a record of which rows have none
      Exit: O2 — every submission named by the index for the range agreed in the stage's own session is on disk, or is listed as missing with its reason.
      Leaves out: manifests and replay (Stage 4); correction tracking (Stage 5); validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: 10-K and 8-K handling
      Objective: Pick the 10-K and 8-K filings out of the submissions and extract their main documents.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: Stage 1's filing-index table; Stage 2's submissions on disk
      Produces: an extracted main document for each 10-K and 8-K submission on disk, linked to its filing-index row
      Exit: O3 — for every 10-K and 8-K submission on disk, its main document is extracted, or the submission is listed as unextractable with its reason.
      Leaves out: manifests and replay (Stage 4); correction tracking (Stage 5); validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: Manifests and replay
      Objective: Record every downloaded source and its processing in manifests, and reprocess retained inputs without downloading again.
      Outcomes: none — hardens O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–3's outputs
      Produces: manifests and replay over the index files, submissions and extracted documents
      Exit: each index file, submission and extracted document traces to its source URL and content hash; a parser change re-runs over retained inputs with no SEC request.
      Leaves out: correction tracking (Stage 5); validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: Correction tracking
      Objective: Re-read the quarterly index files and account for later changes to them without losing earlier versions.
      Outcomes: none — hardens O1
      Consumes: Stage 4's manifests and replay
      Produces: correction tracking for the filing-index table
      Exit: a changed quarterly index file yields a recorded set of additions, changes and removals, and the table as of any earlier run can still be read.
      Leaves out: validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Validation suite
      Objective: Cover the historical index formats, the submissions and the extraction with committed fixtures and failure cases.
      Outcomes: none — hardens O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–5's outputs
      Produces: a validation suite that runs in CI with no SEC access
      Exit: CI passes on fixtures covering each index format in the ingested range, malformed and HTML-error responses, and 10-K and 8-K extraction cases, without a network request.
      Leaves out: scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 7: Scheduling and deployment
      Objective: Run daily ingestion and periodic correction tracking on a schedule, on a chosen platform, with monitoring.
      Outcomes: none — hardens O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–6's outputs
      Produces: scheduling and deployment of the ingestion
      Exit: scheduled runs complete on their own and catch up after a missed run, and a failed run raises an alert; the evidence is recorded from observed scheduled runs.
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming
